Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Bulwark Field (EC12)

ACTION • Burn 3 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Sphere 1 centered on a point you can see

Effect: Create an immobile field until the start of your next Turn. Every creature inside it gains +2 Resilience while inside. This includes enemies. Leaving ends the bonus; reentering restores the bonus but does not reset accumulated Damage or restore Wounds. Overlapping Bulwark Fields do not stack.

Design note: Changing Resilience causes no retroactive Wounds or healing. The field is not a solid barrier and does not block targeting.
